info.title: WebhookControl
info.description: Authenticated generic JSON ingress and OAuth-protected management over REST and MCP with transactional SQLite history.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Exactly one header. Source-scoped visible ASCII key; changing raw body bytes with this key returns 409.

parameters.name: X-Webhook-Timestamp
parameters.description: Required in HMAC mode. Exactly one canonical decimal Unix-second value, within five minutes of server time after the body is read.

requestBody.description: Exactly one JSON object. Only application/json with optional charset=utf-8 is accepted. No compression.

200.description: Immediate mode: all observed attempts succeeded, or a duplicate receipt. Duplicate unknown outcomes never authorize resending.

202.description: Durable event, deduplication and all initial sanitized jobs committed atomically, or matching durable duplicate. No matching route still commits with an empty delivery list.

400.description: Malformed, nonobject or trailing JSON; invalid source/key; unsupported content type or encoding.

401.description: Source authentication failed; source is unknown; HMAC timestamp is stale or signature invalid.

403.description: Authenticated source is disabled or destination policy denied the configuration.

422.description: Configuration/rule/template validation, bounded evaluation or JSON conversion failed before acceptance.

429.description: Per-source rate limit or bounded limiter capacity exceeded.

502.description: Immediate mode: a recorded attempt failed or the first foreground fanout exhausted its time budget. No durable retry; same-key requests never send again.

503.description: Configuration, acceptance storage, immediate support or outcome metadata unavailable. A commit or send may already have occurred; retrying the same key resolves its receipt without resending immediate work.

post.description: The active source selects bearer or HMAC authentication. JSON is limited to one uncompressed object, 1 MiB, depth 64 and 65,536 values. A keyed receipt lookup precedes CEL so duplicates retain the original IDs and delivery mode after configuration changes. Source quota defaults to 60 requests per minute, including authentication failures.
Shared command route. Concrete operation paths below carry exact schemas. Expected revision compares latest_revision for config_put and active_revision for activate, rollback and replay.

200.description: Authorized operation result; secret values are never returned. Result shapes may be shared by multiple operations.

409.description: Expected revision does not match current revision.

410.description: Required original or delivery payload has expired or was never stored.

post.description: Authenticated MCP transport. tools/list exposes permitted tools; tools/call uses Operation names and ManagementRequest arguments. Every invocation repeats source/action authorization. MCP protocol envelopes follow its negotiated version.

sourceBearer.description: The active source must select bearer mode. Uses its immutable server-provisioned source secret, 16–4096 bytes; comparison is constant-time.

sourceHMAC.name: X-Webhook-Signature

managementOAuth.description: RS256 JWT access token with protected header typ=at+jwt, pinned external iss, aud equal to the configured /mcp resource URL for both REST and MCP, nonempty sub, future exp, and scope webhook-control.manage. ID tokens are rejected. HTTP issuers require an explicit loopback-only test option.

sourceTimestamp.name: X-Webhook-Timestamp
sourceTimestamp.description: Required with sourceHMAC. Canonical decimal Unix seconds, within five minutes of the injected current clock after the body is read. No leading zeroes, plus sign or repeated header.

Error.description: Safe error; includes no secrets or payload bytes.

Management400.description: Malformed input, unknown fields, missing expected revision or invalid cursor.

Management401.description: Missing or invalid access token; WWW-Authenticate advertises pinned protected-resource metadata.

Management403.description: Scope, grant, origin, destination, secret-name or retention authority denied.

Management404.description: Resource does not exist in the requested source.

Management409.description: Stale revision, immutable resource conflict, invalid retry state or request-key conflict.

Management410.description: Required original or delivery payload was never stored or has expired.

Management422.description: Invalid configuration, unavailable or wrong-purpose credential, evaluation failed, or selected zero-delivery-TTL replay requires immediate sends.

Management503.description: Storage or configuration unavailable; retry the same request key when acknowledgement is uncertain.

Retention.description: Seconds from acceptance. -1 indefinite, 0 never persist payload, positive expires. Delivery 0 requires immediate mode without durable retries.

RetentionLimit.description: Grant ceiling for original or delivery TTL: permit 0 through max_seconds; -1 requires allow_indefinite=true. Missing limits permit only 0.

ManagementRequest.description: Select the operation-specific envelope from its concrete route. Envelope shapes may be shared by multiple operations. Identity and administrator authority are never caller JSON fields.

IngressEvent.description: One arbitrary incoming object. Maximum raw JSON body 1,048,576 bytes, nesting depth 64 and 65,536 total JSON values. Integers within int64 preserve precision; other finite numbers use double precision. CEL sees this as event.

ImmediateResult.description: Metadata only. Unknown includes a crashed or ambiguous attempt, missing metadata, or an unattempted destination after the total budget elapsed. None is automatically resent.
